             graph.node(node).is_some()
                 && (status == success_status_at(graph, node, false, false)
                     || status == success_status_at(graph, node, false, true))
         }
         Reply::Started { .. } | Reply::AttemptBegun { .. } => status == WorkStatus::Active,
